title: sacdj's The Dungeon additions
description: A pack made for the game The Dungeon on the DiamondFire server for QOL. Note requires CIT capable mod!
body:
# Quality of life for dungeneering!
 list of features
-  Differantiates between the 3 heart pot and 5 heart pot

Get this pack for more QOL when playing the game "The Dungeon" on the DiamondFire server!

### Make sure to check the versions tab to see dependencies!
For 1.21.2+ use Optifine for CIT features
